title: GetReviewDto
description: GetReviewDto schema from Quandoo Public Partner API

merchantId.description: Merchant Id associated to this review. Only in detailed view.

identifier.description: Identifier of the customer associated to this review. Only in detailed view.

firstName.description: Customer first name associated to this review. Only in detailed view.

lastName.description: First letter of customer last name associated to this review. Only in detailed view.

profileImage.description: Customer profile image URL associated to this review. Only in detailed view.

status.description: Current review status. Possible values are 'AVAILABLE_TO_REVIEW','CREATED', 'DENIED', 'PUBLISHED'.

locale.description: Locale of the created review. Only in detailed view.

rating.description: Rating associated to this review. Possible values: 1 to 6.

reservationId.description: The reservation identifier this review is created for.

createdAt.description: The date the review created on. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
